walk_to_case_file.title: FIRST DAY, FIRST DRAWER
walk_to_case_file.objective: Walk over to the case-file cabinet.
walk_to_case_file.hint: Use the movement controls and approach the cabinet marked by the glowing frame.

open_case_file.title: THE CASE FILE
open_case_file.objective: Open the case file in the cabinet.
open_case_file.hint: Click the cabinet when you are close enough. Bureaucracy has never been this dangerous.

find_route.title: FOLLOW THE GLOBE
find_route.objective: Use the globe to choose your destination.
find_route.hint: The globe is the agency travel desk, because apparently airports were too expensive.

travel_to_city.title: FIELD WORK
travel_to_city.hint: Choose the destination and begin the investigation before the trail gets cold.
